hooks.command: f=$(grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"\|"filePath":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4 | head -1); if [[ "$f" =~ \.dart$ ]] && [[ -f "$f" ]]; then dart format "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

f=$(grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"\|"filePath":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4 | head -1); if [[ "$f" =~ lib/.+\.dart$ ]] && [[ "$f" =~ (cubit|repository|datasource|use_case)\.dart$ ]]; then echo "[Hook] DI regeneration may be needed after changes to $f"; fi
cmd=$(grep -o '"command":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4 | head -1); if [[ "$cmd" =~ ^flutter\ test ]]; then echo "[Hook] Running Flutter tests: $cmd"; fi

if [ -d .git ] && [ "$(git status --porcelain | wc -l)" -gt 0 ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "💾 You have uncommitted changes. Consider running: git add . && git commit -m \"Session changes\" or use /commit"}'; fi
